description: A 使者 (messenger) relay record for a worker's resignation (per ADR-2606112238). kadode 門出 conveys a worker's ALREADY-FORMED, unilateral resignation declaration (民法627 — a unilateral right; the employer's consent is not required) to the employer. It is a MESSENGER, never a 代理人 (agent): it does NOT and cannot negotiate terms, severance, or settlements (弁護士法72条) — any matter needing negotiation produces a `com.etzhayyim.kadode.escalation` instead. The document body lives on IPFS (referenced by `documentCid`); PII (worker/employer detail) is held in a himotoki XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope (ADR-2605181100), never plaintext on MST. The record is created UNSENT; actually transmitting it is a G7-gated outward action requiring the worker's consent (no-server-key).

workerDid.description: DID of the worker whose own resignation this relays. The resignation is the worker's act; kadode only conveys it.

scenario.description: kadode labour-exit scenario id (`sc.*`) classifying the situation.

employerRef.description: Opaque reference to the employer (hash / himotoki-enveloped handle). Never plaintext employer PII on MST (ADR-2605181100).

documentCid.description: IPFS CIDv1 (raw/sha2-256) of the resignation document (退職届 etc.). Re-derivable with `ipfs add --cid-version=1 --raw-leaves`.

documentSha256.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase hex SHA-256 of the document body.

role.description: Always the messenger role. kadode is a 使者, never an agent (G1).

negotiates.description: MUST be false. kadode never negotiates (弁護士法72条); a true value is structurally invalid.

statutoryBasis.description: The DISCLOSED statutory basis of the unilateral resignation, e.g. 民法627条1項. A disclosed fact, never an enforceability verdict (N3).

status.description: Lifecycle. Created `drafted-unsent`; transmission (`sent`) is a separate G7-gated outward action with worker consent (no-server-key).
